# Aquvana Water

> Simple. Pure. Yours. Premium custom-branded packaged drinking water for luxury hotels, boutique resorts, fine-dining restaurants, destination weddings, and corporate events across Rishikesh, Haridwar, Dehradun, and India.

## Overview
Aquvana (Aquvana Water LLP) is a bespoke drinking water packaging studio based in Tapovan, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India. We empower hospitality brands, wedding planners, and businesses to transform a mundane water bottle into a memorable, premium branding touchpoint.

## Core Pages & URLs
- [Home Page](https://www.aquvana.in/): Interactive 3D bottle customizer, value propositions, client showcase, trust badges, and sample designs.
- [Products](https://www.aquvana.in/products): Specifications of 250ml Welcome, 500ml Dining, and 1L Suite bottles, label stocks (Ultra-Matte Velvet, Gloss BOPP, Metallic Foil Accent), and multi-stage RO+UV purification.
- [Pricing](https://www.aquvana.in/pricing): Volume-based transparent tier pricing (Starter Batch 500 units, Hospitality Standard 1,000 units, High Volume 5,000 units, Enterprise 10,000+ units), cost variables, and interactive calculator.
- [Get a Custom Quote](https://www.aquvana.in/quote): Interactive 4-step quote wizard for immediate cost estimates and complimentary 24-hour 3D digital proof.
- [About Us](https://www.aquvana.in/about): The story behind Aquvana, hospitality thesis, local Uttarakhand manufacturing, and 4-step workflow integrity (Design, Production, Quality, Delivery).
- [Contact Us](https://www.aquvana.in/contact): Studio location in Tapovan Rishikesh, direct phone desks, WhatsApp concierge lines, email, service corridors, and operating hours.

## Key Offerings & Bottle Silhouettes
1. **250ml Welcome Silhouette ("The Reception / Welcome Edition")**:
   - Ideal for hotel lobbies, guest check-in, conference meeting rooms, boardroom tables, and wedding welcome hampers.
   - Material: Optically clear, 100% food-grade virgin BPA-free PET.
   - Cap: Tamper-evident airtight closure.
2. **500ml Dining Silhouette ("The Hospitality Standard")**:
   - Ideal for banquet tables, restaurant dining, guest rooms, and wedding reception dining.
   - Material: Heavyweight virgin PET with ergonomic grip.
   - Label: 360-degree cylindrical wrap canvas.
3. **1000ml (1 Litre) Suite Silhouette ("The Executive / Long-Stay Edition")**:
   - Ideal for luxury suites, villas, bedside carafes, conference plenaries, and all-day retreat sessions.

## Label Finishes & Durability
- **Ultra-Matte Velvet**: Silky soft-touch feel, anti-glare, understated luxury for boutique resorts and editorial wedding themes.
- **High-Gloss BOPP**: Brilliant color vibrancy, high optical sheen, 100% waterproof.
- **Metallic Foil Accent**: Hot-stamped gold, silver, or copper foil highlights on logos and monograms.
- **Submersion Resistance**: All labels are 100% waterproof and guaranteed not to smudge, bleed, or peel inside iced beverage tubs or refrigerators.

## Water Quality & Filtration Standards
- 8-stage purification process including multi-barrier Reverse Osmosis (RO), UV microbiological sterilization, micron sediment polishing, and essential mineral balancing.
- Meets and exceeds all FSSAI and Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) drinking water regulations.

## Primary Service Areas & Logistics
- **Local Express Delivery**: Rishikesh, Haridwar, Dehradun, Mussoorie, and Shivpuri.
- **Freight Delivery**: Delhi NCR, Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and pan-India logistics networks.
